blocks.content: Before you code, let's think about how a countdown timer works.

items: A variable to store the remaining time (starts at 30)
A place on screen to display the time

Code that runs every second to:
		Decrease the time by 1Update the displayCheck if time reached zero

blocks.content: How setInterval helps: Remember setInterval from spawning moles? You'll use it again here! But instead of spawning moles, it will decrease the timer every second (1000 milliseconds).
Think of it like a countdown on your phone—every second, the number gets smaller until it reaches zero.
Let's build it step by step!
